usage.text:
The 1 kg weight falls from rest and strikes the seesaw at 0.78 s. The seesaw rotates, lifting and launching the initially resting 100 g ball; the ball leaves the seesaw at 0.84 s and touches the overhead height marker at 0.87 s.
